data.one_liner: Flutter interface for Flic2 Bluetooth buttons on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the official Flic2 native libraries to let Flutter applications search for, connect to, disconnect, and listen for press and release events from Flic 2 hardware buttons. Supports Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to integrate Flic 2 Bluetooth hardware buttons into your mobile app.
Your app needs to trigger actions based on button presses, double-presses, or holds from physical Flic buttons.
avoid_when: You require a persistent background service to handle button presses while the Flutter application is completely destroyed.
You are using the original first-generation Flic buttons, which are not currently supported.
strengths: Direct integration with official Flic2 Android and iOS SDKs.
Exposes search, connection management, and button click callbacks cleanly to Dart.
weaknesses: Does not support background execution if the app is destroyed.
Requires manual configuration of native permissions for Bluetooth and Location on both Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration of Bluetooth and Location permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist, alongside minimum SDK adjustments and Gradle modifications.
